name: Lavan
source:
‘Geez, you’re really so…… I don’t what to do with myself when you say things like that.’

A young man who is next in line to lead the Wolf family. He always chooses his actions while thinking of others, and is respected and loved by many. He is the leader of the vigilante that is made up of young men from the Wolf family. He is always a step ahead of the heroine, and is an older brother-like existence to her.

[From [url=https://sakura52-blog.tumblr.com/post/174361157222/psychedelica-of-the-ashen-hawk-character-profiles]Sakura52's blog[/url]]
